definitions.explanation: Used to count long, thin objects such as pencils, bottles, umbrellas, bananas, roads, and train lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三本|さんぼん}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何本|なんぼん}⟦{食|た}べました→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many bananas did you eat?

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二本|にほん}⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought two bottles of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三本|さんぼん}⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I watched three movies, but this one was the most interesting.

notes:
〜⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ counts long, thin, cylindrical objects.

WHAT IT COUNTS:
- Writing tools: ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧, ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧, ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧
- Bottles/containers: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧, ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボトル→ボトル：11270_botoru⟧
- Elongated items: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧, ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧, ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧
- Routes and lines: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧, ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧, ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧
- By extension, things that run from start to finish in one stretch: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (phone calls), ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (films), and a goal in soccer

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ぽん (after 1, 6, 8, 10): ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧, ⟦{六本|ろっぽん}→六本：27650_roppon⟧, {八本|はっぽん}, {十本|じゅっぽん}
- ぼん (after 3): {三本|さんぼん}
- ほん (others): {二本|にほん}, {四本|よんほん}, {五本|ごほん}, {七本|ななほん}, {九本|きゅうほん}

QUESTION FORM:
{何本|なんぼん}: how many (long objects)?

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦〜{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ is the shape opposite: wide and thin rather than long and thin.
- ⟦〜{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ counts bound volumes. Despite the shared character, a ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ (book) is never counted with 〜⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ — it is ⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧.
- ⟦〜{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ takes over when an object is small and has no dominant long axis.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧ is also the call for a full point in ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧ and ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧, awarded for a decisive technique.
